headline: Türkiye's Central Bank Signals Potential Tax Measures to Defend Lira
summary: Central Bank of Türkiye Governor announced the central bank could use macroprudential tools, liquidity measures, and potential tax policies alongside interest rates to support lira demand.
why: The Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye uses monetary and credit controls to curb high inflation and stabilize the Turkish lira.

impacts.name: Turkish Lira
impacts.why: The CBRT's announcement of liquidity and tax interventions directly affects Turkish lira exchange rate expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Central bank policy statements regarding additional tax and liquidity measures aimed at protecting the domestic currency influenced foreign exchange market pricing.
